<thought>Based on the spectrum, the most prominent isotopic pattern is a peak at m/z 213 that is about one‑third the intensity of the base peak at m/z 211. This 3 : 1 M : M+2 ratio matches the natural isotopic distribution of chlorine (35Cl ≈ 75 % and 37Cl ≈ 25 %). No other element shows a characteristic pattern of this magnitude in the data. Therefore, chlorine can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
